dependencies: Phase 46: regime_gates, mtf_confluence, session_detector, ensemble_conflict, expectancy_tracker
Phase 47: pipeline wiring of all Phase 46 modules
goal: Close the feedback loop: detect when edge disappears, filter bad conditions, attribute outcomes, optimize parameters dynamically. Target win rate improvement from 38% toward 42-45%.
research_sources: PPO auxiliary tasks for FX trading (arxiv 2405.19982)

acceptance_criteria: SpreadFilter class with configurable threshold (default 0.20 = 20% of ATR)
Fetches current bid/ask from OANDA pricing endpoint
Calculates normalized_spread = spread_pips / atr_pips
Returns SpreadCheckResult with pass/fail, spread value, threshold
Wired into execute_trade() as pre-execution gate
Graceful fallback: if spread unavailable, allow trade with warning
At least 8 unit tests covering: pass, fail, edge cases, fallback
stories.description: Create a spread filter that normalizes current spread as a percentage of ATR. Skip trades when normalized spread exceeds threshold (default 20%). Integrate as a pre-execution gate in execution.py.
stories.notes: SpreadFilter with 29 tests. Normalizes spread/ATR with pair overrides, size_multiplier property, graceful ATR=0 fallback.
stories.title: Spread-Aware Entry Gate

acceptance_criteria: EconomicCalendarFilter class with configurable blackout windows
Fetches daily calendar from Finnhub API (free tier, 60 calls/min)
Local JSON cache refreshed every 4 hours (atomic write)
HIGH impact: 30min blackout before event, 5min after
MEDIUM impact: 15min blackout, position size reduction 50%
LOW impact: no action (log only)
Currency-pair matching (USD events affect all USD pairs)
Graceful fallback: if API unavailable, allow trades with warning
At least 10 unit tests covering: blackout detection, currency matching, cache, fallback
stories.description: Integrate economic calendar data to create blackout periods around high-impact news events. Use Finnhub free API as primary source with local cache fallback. Block new entries 30min before HIGH-impact events, reduce size 50% for MEDIUM-impact within 15min.
stories.notes: EconomicCalendarFilter with 24 tests. HIGH/MEDIUM impact blackout windows, currency-pair matching, atomic cache, dedup, post-event buffer.
stories.title: Economic Calendar News Filter

acceptance_criteria: StrategyFitnessDetector class with rolling 20-trade window
Metrics: rolling_profit_factor, prediction_correlation, avg_agent_disagreement
Fitness score: weighted composite (PF 0.4, correlation 0.3, disagreement 0.3)
Thresholds: fitness < 0.4 = SKIP, 0.4-0.6 = REDUCE_SIZE, > 0.6 = NORMAL
Per-pair per-regime tracking with atomic JSON persistence
Minimum 10 trades before evaluation (insufficient data = NORMAL)
Integrated into pre-execution gate chain
At least 10 unit tests
stories.description: Monitor rolling strategy fitness per pair. Calculate rolling profit factor, prediction-outcome correlation, and agent disagreement trend. When fitness drops below threshold, reduce position size or skip pair. Detects when the system's edge has disappeared for a specific pair/regime.
stories.estimated_impact: 2-4% win rate improvement by avoiding low-fitness conditions
stories.notes: StrategyFitnessDetector with 20 tests. Rolling fitness score (PF 0.4 + corr 0.3 + disagree 0.3). SKIP/REDUCE_SIZE/NORMAL per pair per regime.
stories.title: Strategy Fitness Detector

acceptance_criteria: PairPerformanceTracker class with rolling 30-day window
Metrics per pair: sharpe_ratio, win_rate, consecutive_losses, max_drawdown_pct
Auto-blacklist rules: sharpe < 0.5 OR consec_losses >= 4 OR drawdown > 10%
Blacklist duration: 2 scan cycles (configurable)
Minimum 10 trades before blacklisting (prevents noise-driven blacklisting)
Atomic JSON persistence to trained_data/models/pair_tracker.json
update_from_trade() called in sync_closed_trades_rl()
is_pair_blacklisted(pair) called in engine scan loop
At least 10 unit tests
stories.description: Track per-pair performance metrics (Sharpe, win rate, consecutive losses, max drawdown) with automatic blacklisting. Pairs with Sharpe < 0.5 or 4+ consecutive losses get temporarily blacklisted. Integrates with pair selection in engine.py scan loop.
stories.estimated_impact: 1-3% improvement by avoiding persistently unprofitable pairs
stories.notes: PairPerformanceTracker with 22 tests. Auto-blacklist on sharpe<0.5, consec_losses>=4, drawdown>10%. Cooldown cycle system.
stories.title: Dynamic Pair Performance Tracker & Blacklisting

acceptance_criteria: TradeAttributionEngine class
For each closed trade: record agent verdicts, weights, and individual scores
Attribution: compare each agent's signal direction with actual outcome
Calculate per-agent accuracy_rate, contribution_score, alignment_ratio
Generate attribution_report per trade (stored in trade journal)
Aggregate attribution by agent across last 50 trades
Feed attribution into expectancy_tracker for weight adjustment
Atomic JSON persistence
At least 8 unit tests
stories.description: After each closed trade, attribute the outcome to agent contributions using a lightweight SHAP-inspired approach. Identify which agents drove the decision and whether their individual signals aligned with the outcome. Feeds back into agent weight optimization.
stories.estimated_impact: Enables data-driven agent reweighting for 1-2% win rate lift
stories.notes: TradeAttributionEngine with 18 tests. SHAP-inspired per-agent alignment scoring. Weight recommendations from accuracy_rate. Aggregate performance.
stories.title: Trade Outcome Attribution Engine

acceptance_criteria: WalkForwardOptimizer class with configurable window sizes
Optimizes: confidence_threshold, momentum_threshold, atr_sl_multiplier, atr_tp_multiplier
In-sample: grid search on parameter ranges (brute force, small grid)
Out-of-sample: calculate profit factor and Sharpe on held-out trades
WFE = OOS_profit_factor / IS_profit_factor (flag if < 0.30)
Runs every 75 closed trades (60 IS + 15 OOS)
Writes recommended parameters to config_adjustments.json
Does NOT auto-apply: logs recommendation, requires manual review
At least 10 unit tests
stories.description: Implement anchored walk-forward optimization for gate thresholds (confidence, momentum, risk) and ATR multipliers. Uses rolling 60-trade in-sample window to find optimal parameters, validates on 15-trade out-of-sample window. Calculates Walk-Forward Efficiency (WFE) to detect overfitting.
stories.estimated_impact: Prevents parameter staleness, 1-2% sustained edge preservation
stories.notes: WalkForwardOptimizer with 20 tests. Anchored IS/OOS grid search. WFE overfitting detection. Writes recommendations to config_adjustments.json (no auto-apply).
stories.title: Walk-Forward Gate Parameter Optimizer
